title: Bacterial DNA Isolation Miniprep Protocol
author: Magdalena M Julkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pendjde

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin 3 mL of overnight culture (1.5 mL per tube) at 13,000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Lyse cells with P1 and RNase
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL P1 solution and 5 µL RNase to the cell pellet, vortex to resuspend, then incubate 15 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL P1 solution and 5 µL RNase to the pellet

steps.title: Neutralize lysate with P2
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL P2 solution, mix gently, and incubate 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins with P3
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL P3 solution and mix gently.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by high‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Spin the mixture at the maximum speed of the centrifuge for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer 750 µL of the supernatant to a new tube, add 750 µL isopropanol, and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 750 µL supernatant to a new tube

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 30 minutes at 14,000 rpm.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, wash the pellet with 80 % ethanol, and spin for 10 minutes at maximum speed.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for 10 minutes and remove any remaining ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Air‑dry pellet at room temperature for 10 min

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL sterile Milli‑Q water to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Quantify and store DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer and store the DNA at –20 °C.
